m: peśala mf(ā)n. (g. sidhmādi) artificially formed, adorned, decorated, VS.; TBr.
beautiful, charming, lovely, pleasant, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
peśala m. N. of Viṣṇu, V.
peśala n. charm, grace, beauty, loveliness, BhP.
a: peśa(ṣa-sa)la a. 1 Soft, tender, delicate; puṣpacāpamiva peśalaṃ smaraḥ R. 11. 45; 9. 40; Me. 93. 2 Thin, slender (as waist); R. 13. 34. 3 Lovely, beautiful, charming, good; Bv. 2. 2. 4 Expert, clever, skilful; Bh. 3. 56; ekonmīlanapeśalaḥ U. 6. 34. 5 Crafty, fraudulent. 6 Decorated, adorned. — laṃ Beauty. — laḥ N. of Viṣṇu.
